title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Charges Due Rebuilt from the Account
content:
## Clause

For a remittance that covers a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file's charges in full, the charges due are not read off the balance displayed on the acceptance. They are rebuilt from the account: the total of the charge-side entries less the total of the credit-side entries, both taken over the acceptance's whole life. The difference is a whole number of cents and is written to two decimal places.

## Worked example (invented amounts)

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Charge side in total | 1437.60 |
| Credit side in total | 630.00 |
| Charges due | 807.60 |

## Points of judgement

**The balance field on the acceptance shows a different figure from the rebuilt one.** The rebuilt figure governs.
